basic_profile.bio: A 25-year-old tech enthusiast based in Austin, Texas, exploring the world of Reddit and Pokémon trading. By day, I work as a junior network administrator at a local IT firm. I enjoy gaming, especially Pokémon, and collecting rare in-game items. When I'm not trading Pokémon, I'm either hitting the local skate parks or diving into new cybersecurity trends. Usually online during evenings and weekends. Currently single and loving the freedom to explore my hobbies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: A self-taught tech aficionado with a background in computer networks, learned through online courses and on-the-job training. Recently developed a keen interest in cybersecurity and digital trading platforms.
